response.overview: Her Wedding" tells the story of an elder sister, Jun, who tries to stop her younger sister, Hua, from marrying a disabled single father, only to discover that Hua's decision stems from gender identity struggles and emotional trauma, leading her to self-exile. In the end, Hua defiantly holds the wedding to resist societal gossip, while Jun, helpless, leaves with regret. The sisters' estrangement and deep affection intertwine amidst the clash between tradition and modernity
response.title: Her Wedding
